title: US woman falsely charged with bank theft sues for $10m over AI facial recognition

reports.title: US woman falsely charged with bank theft sues for $10m over AI facial recognition

summary:
Angela Lipps, a 50 year old Tennessee woman, was arrested at gunpoint in July 2025 and jailed for about six months after Fargo, North Dakota police falsely charged her with bank theft. She was held nearly four months in a Tennessee county jail without bail, then about two more months in North Dakota. The four theft and four identity fraud charges were dropped after her lawyer showed bank records proving she was in Tennessee at the time. Lipps was released on Christmas Eve, and she says she lost her home, car, and belongings.

Lipps has now filed a federal lawsuit seeking $10 million in damages from the city of Fargo and police detective Lucas Heck. The suit says investigators relied on an AI facial recognition match from a fake ID and her social media photo, without enough further investigation, to request an arrest warrant. It also claims Fargo lacked proper policies and training for facial recognition use. The city said it does not comment on pending litigation, and the case will now move forward in federal court.
title_en: US woman falsely charged with bank theft sues for $10m over AI facial recognition
